topic: Will injectable, disease-fighting nanobots ever be a reality?
unit_of_analysis: carrier batch, microfluidic run, donor sample, and randomized animal block

arms.purpose: carrier and gate without active payload

stages.name: quality_and_assay
stages.deliverable: critical quality attributes, gate specificity, payload and immune assay qualification

stages.name: human_vascular_microfluidics
stages.deliverable: flow-dependent arrival, residence, localization, opening, and release

stages.name: ex_vivo_blood
stages.deliverable: protein corona, complement, cytokine, platelet, hemolysis, and coagulation compatibility

stages.name: staged_mouse_study
stages.deliverable: blinded biodistribution, pharmacodynamics, efficacy, clearance, and repeat-dose safety

stages.name: conditional_large_animal
stages.deliverable: human-relevant anatomy, monitoring, rescue, and translation evidence

statistical_plan: hierarchical mixed-effects model plus preregistered Bayesian evidence and frequentist intervals
